new_theorem_types.name: CurrentMM.p1_endogenous_contraction_sensitivity
new_theorem_types.type:
∀ (x y Lk Lg epsilon : ℝ),
  0 ≤ Lk →
    0 ≤ Lg →
      0 ≤ epsilon → Lk * Lg < 1 → |x - y| ≤ Lk * (Lg * |x - y| + epsilon) → |x - y| ≤ Lk * epsilon / (1 - Lk * Lg)

new_theorem_types.name: CurrentMM.p1_sybil_share_count_bound
new_theorem_types.type: ∀ {M : ℕ} (shares : Fin M → ℝ) (alpha : ℝ), (∀ (i : Fin M), alpha ≤ shares i) → ∑ i, shares i = 1 → ↑M * alpha ≤ 1

new_theorem_types.name: CurrentMM.p1_camouflage_unprofitable
new_theorem_types.type: ∀ (cost profit lower upper : ℝ), lower ≤ cost → profit ≤ upper → upper < lower → profit - cost < 0

new_theorem_types.name: CurrentMM.p1_flow_ratio_interval
new_theorem_types.type:
∀ (f0 f1 h f0lo f0hi f1lo f1hi hlo hhi κ : ℝ),
  0 < κ →
    0 < f0lo →
      0 ≤ f1lo →
        f0lo ≤ f0 →
          f0 ≤ f0hi →
            f1lo ≤ f1 →
              f1 ≤ f1hi →
                hlo ≤ h → h ≤ hhi → f1lo / f0hi - hhi / κ ≤ f1 / f0 - h / κ ∧ f1 / f0 - h / κ ≤ f1hi / f0lo - hlo / κ

new_theorem_types.name: CurrentMM.p1_flow_intensity_interval
new_theorem_types.type:
∀ (w r wlo whi rlo rhi : ℝ),
  0 ≤ wlo →
    wlo ≤ w → w ≤ whi → rlo ≤ r → r ≤ rhi → rhi < 1 → wlo / (1 - rlo) ≤ w / (1 - r) ∧ w / (1 - r) ≤ whi / (1 - rhi)

new_theorem_types.name: CurrentMM.p1_flow_selected_halt_sound
new_theorem_types.type:
∀ {K : ℕ} (q upper : Fin K → ℝ) (i : Fin K) (a κ drift allowance cap : ℝ),
  0 ≤ κ →
    (∀ (j : Fin K), q j ≤ upper j) →
      drift ≤ allowance →
        a + κ * ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, upper j + allowance ≤ cap →
          a + κ * ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, q j + drift ≤ cap

new_theorem_types.name: CurrentMM.p1_flow_joint_mean_bound
new_theorem_types.type:
∀ {J : ℕ} (N : ℕ),
  0 < N →
    ∀ (mean : Fin J → ℝ) (v : NNReal) (e : ℝ),
      0 < e →
        (MeasureTheory.Measure.pi fun j => MeasureTheory.Measure.pi fun x => ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal (mean j) v)
            (⋃ j, {x | e ≤ |(∑ n, x j n) / ↑N - mean j|}) ≤
          ↑J * ENNReal.ofReal (↑v / (↑N * e ^ 2))

new_theorem_types.name: CurrentMM.p1_flow_identity_inversion
new_theorem_types.type: ∀ (w κ r h : ℝ), w ≠ 0 → κ ≠ 0 → w * (κ * r + h) / (κ * w) - h / κ = r

new_theorem_types.name: CurrentMM.p1_flow_clipped_interval
new_theorem_types.type: ∀ (lo hi r cap : ℝ), lo ≤ r → r ≤ hi → 0 ≤ r → r ≤ cap → max 0 (min cap lo) ≤ r ∧ r ≤ max 0 (min cap hi)

new_theorem_types.name: CurrentMM.p1_flow_gaussian_decision_bound
new_theorem_types.type:
∀ {J : ℕ} (N : ℕ),
  0 < N →
    ∀ (mean : Fin J → ℝ) (v : NNReal) (e : ℝ),
      0 < e →
        ∀ (halt violates : (Fin J → Fin N → ℝ) → Prop),
          (∀ (x : Fin J → Fin N → ℝ), (∀ (j : Fin J), |(∑ n, x j n) / ↑N - mean j| < e) → halt x → ¬violates x) →
            (MeasureTheory.Measure.pi fun j =>
                  MeasureTheory.Measure.pi fun x => ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal (mean j) v)
                {x | halt x ∧ violates x} ≤
              ↑J * ENNReal.ofReal (↑v / (↑N * e ^ 2))

new_theorem_types.name: CurrentMM.p1_gr_node_bounds
new_theorem_types.type: (∀ (i : Fin 2), |CurrentMM.grGNode i| ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ (i : Fin 2), |CurrentMM.grRNode i| ≤ 1

new_theorem_types.name: CurrentMM.p1_gr_positive_weights
new_theorem_types.type: (∀ (i : Fin 2), 0 < CurrentMM.grGWeight i) ∧ ∀ (i : Fin 2), 0 < CurrentMM.grRWeight i

new_theorem_types.name: CurrentMM.p1_gr_normalized_weights
new_theorem_types.type: ∑ i, CurrentMM.grGWeight i = 1 ∧ ∑ i, CurrentMM.grRWeight i = 1

new_theorem_types.name: CurrentMM.p1_gr_three_matched_moments
new_theorem_types.type:
∀ (W : ℝ),
  ∀ j < 3,
    ∑ i, W * CurrentMM.grGWeight i * CurrentMM.grGNode i ^ j = ∑ i, W * CurrentMM.grRWeight i * CurrentMM.grRNode i ^ j

new_theorem_types.name: CurrentMM.p1_gr_third_moment_gap
new_theorem_types.type:
∀ (W : ℝ),
  ∑ i, W * CurrentMM.grGWeight i * CurrentMM.grGNode i ^ 3 - ∑ i, W * CurrentMM.grRWeight i * CurrentMM.grRNode i ^ 3 =
    2 * W / 9

new_theorem_types.name: CurrentMM.p1_gr_dominant_intensity_gap
new_theorem_types.type:
∀ (W u d : ℝ),
  0 < W →
    0 < u →
      0 ≤ d →
        d ≤ u / 3 →
          ∀ (i : Fin 2),
            CurrentMM.grIntensity CurrentMM.grGWeight CurrentMM.grGNode W u d i ≤
              CurrentMM.grIntensity CurrentMM.grRWeight CurrentMM.grRNode W u d 1 - W / (8 * u)

new_theorem_types.name: CurrentMM.p1_gr_aggregate_gap
new_theorem_types.type:
∀ (W u d : ℝ),
  0 < W →
    0 ≤ d →
      d < u →
        |∑ i, CurrentMM.grIntensity CurrentMM.grGWeight CurrentMM.grGNode W u d i -
              ∑ i, CurrentMM.grIntensity CurrentMM.grRWeight CurrentMM.grRNode W u d i| ≤
          2 * W * d ^ 3 / (u ^ 3 * (u - d))

new_theorem_types.name: CurrentMM.p1_gr_reset_lower_bound
new_theorem_types.type:
∀ (a κ c d W H : ℝ) (N T : ℕ) (q rate q' rate' : Fin 2 → ℝ) (variance : NNReal),
  variance ≠ 0 →
    0 ≤ c →
      0 ≤ d →
        c + d ≤ 1 →
          0 < W →
            0 ≤ H →
              (∀ (i : Fin 2), 1 - rate i = c + d * CurrentMM.grGNode i) →
                (∀ (i : Fin 2), 1 - rate' i = c + d * CurrentMM.grRNode i) →
                  (∀ (i : Fin 2), q i * rate i = W * CurrentMM.grGWeight i) →
                    (∀ (i : Fin 2), q' i * rate' i = W * CurrentMM.grRWeight i) →
                      (∀ t < T, |CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse a κ q' rate' t| ≤ H) →
                        ∀ (A : Set (CurrentMM.ObservationRecord (N * T))),
                          MeasurableSet A →
                            (CurrentMM.gaussianRecordLaw (N * T)
                                      (CurrentMM.p1RepeatedMean N T (CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse a κ q rate))
                                      variance).real
                                  A ≤
                                1 / 4 →
                              (CurrentMM.gaussianRecordLaw (N * T)
                                        (CurrentMM.p1RepeatedMean N T (CurrentMM.actualCohortImpulse a κ q' rate'))
                                        variance).real
                                    Aᶜ ≤
                                  1 / 4 →
                                ↑variance ≤ 2 * ↑N * ↑T * (2 * W * 2 ^ T * d ^ 3 * CurrentMM.p1GapConst a |κ| W H T) ^ 2

new_theorem_types.name: CurrentMM.p1_response_robust_threshold
new_theorem_types.type:
∀ (rA rB movedA movedB threshold radius : ℝ),
  rA + radius ≤ threshold →
    threshold < rB - radius → |movedA - rA| ≤ radius → |movedB - rB| ≤ radius → movedA ≤ threshold ∧ threshold < movedB

new_theorem_types.name: CurrentMM.p1_supervisory_gaussian_unsafe_halt
new_theorem_types.type:
∀ (N : ℕ),
  0 < N →
    ∀ (r threshold allowance drift radius : ℝ) (v : NNReal),
      0 < radius →
        drift ≤ allowance →
          (MeasureTheory.Measure.pi fun x => ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal r v)
              {x | (∑ i, x i) / ↑N + radius + allowance ≤ threshold ∧ threshold < r + drift} ≤
            ENNReal.ofReal (↑v / (↑N * radius ^ 2))

new_theorem_types.name: CurrentMM.p1_supervisory_gaussian_unsafe_halt_budget
new_theorem_types.type:
∀ (N : ℕ),
  0 < N →
    ∀ (r threshold allowance drift radius beta : ℝ) (v : NNReal),
      0 < radius →
        drift ≤ allowance →
          ↑v ≤ beta * (↑N * radius ^ 2) →
            (MeasureTheory.Measure.pi fun x => ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal r v)
                {x | (∑ i, x i) / ↑N + radius + allowance ≤ threshold ∧ threshold < r + drift} ≤
              ENNReal.ofReal beta

new_theorem_types.name: CurrentMM.p1_no_data_throttle_optimal
new_theorem_types.type: ∀ (fallback halt p : ℝ), 0 ≤ p → fallback ≤ halt → fallback ≤ p * halt + (1 - p) * fallback

new_theorem_types.name: CurrentMM.p1_no_data_capped_halt_optimal
new_theorem_types.type:
∀ (fallback halt p pMax : ℝ),
  p ≤ pMax → halt ≤ fallback → pMax * halt + (1 - pMax) * fallback ≤ p * halt + (1 - p) * fallback

new_theorem_types.name: CurrentMM.p1_information_purchase_break_even
new_theorem_types.type:
∀ (fallback expectedActionLoss fixedFee perSample n : ℝ),
  fixedFee + n * perSample + expectedActionLoss < fallback ↔ fixedFee + n * perSample < fallback - expectedActionLoss

new_theorem_types.name: CurrentMM.p1_optional_information_value_nonnegative
new_theorem_types.type: ∀ (fallback paid : ℝ), 0 ≤ fallback - min fallback paid

new_theorem_types.name: CurrentMM.p1_robust_uniform_action
new_theorem_types.type:
∀ (a theta sEnvelope s threshold allowance drift : ℝ),
  0 ≤ theta →
    s ≤ sEnvelope →
      a + theta * (sEnvelope - a) + allowance ≤ threshold → drift ≤ allowance → a + theta * (s - a) + drift ≤ threshold
